dimensions.concept: new biological principle (0 none, 1 confirms, 2 extends, 3 new principle)
dimensions.scale: cohort and data scale for the field (0-3)
dimensions.orthogonal: independent modality at single-cell resolution or protein level (0 none, 1 external data only, 2 same tissue, 3 same tissue + quantified)
dimensions.replication: independent cohort replication of the main claims (0-3)
dimensions.function: perturbation evidence (0 none, 1 in silico, 2 in vitro / organoid, 3 organoid or in vivo with mechanism)

note: Bars are Claude's reading of recently published comparators, not journal policy. Edit them when a field scan says otherwise.
